$comment: JSON Schema draft 2020-12, validated via ajv's Ajv2020 class in core/catalog/validate-component.ts.
title: Flow Definition
description: catalog/flows/*.yaml — the only hand-authored catalog artifact. Declares an ordered sequence of components that implement a business flow. Spec: specification-multi-repo-context.md section 5.3.

schemaVersion.description: Schema evolution marker for this artifact type.

domain.description: Must exist in the meta-repo domains.md (enforced by dt catalog validate, not this schema).

owner.description: Manual field — required or the flow is considered abandoned.

component.description: Must resolve to an existing component id in the catalog (enforced by dt catalog validate, not this schema).

via.description: Contract id used to reach this step, when applicable.
